tasks.title: Fix and Verify Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Investigate and fix mobile responsive design issues in the calculator application.

Files to read and check:
- index.html - verify viewport meta tag is correctly configured
- src/components/Calculator.css - verify mobile breakpoints and responsive styles
- src/components/Button.css - ensure buttons scale properly on mobile
- src/components/Display.css - verify display is readable on small screens
- src/App.css - check root-level responsive styles

Fix any issues found:
1. Ensure proper viewport meta tag exists in index.html (width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0)
2. Verify CSS media queries work correctly for mobile devices (320px-768px width)
3. Test that buttons are touch-friendly with minimum 44px tap targets
4. Ensure calculator layout doesn't break on small screens
5. Verify text is readable without horizontal scrolling
6. Check that the calculator container has appropriate max-width and centering

Write or update tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx to verify responsive behavior:
- Calculator renders correctly on mobile viewports
- Buttons are appropriately sized for touch interaction
- Display text is readable on small screens
acceptance_criteria: Viewport meta tag properly configured in index.html
CSS media queries handle mobile screens (min-width 320px)
Buttons meet minimum touch target size (44px)
Calculator layout works on mobile without horizontal scroll

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator application is fully responsive on mobile devices.

Test execution:
1. Run the test suite: npm test
2. Verify all responsive tests pass
3. Start dev server: npm run dev
4. Use Playwright to capture screenshots at multiple mobile viewports:
   - iPhone SE (375x667)
   - iPhone 12 Pro (390x844)
   - Pixel 5 (393x851)
5. Verify visual responsiveness in screenshots:
   - Calculator fits within viewport
   - Buttons are touch-friendly sized
   - Display is readable without zooming
   - No horizontal scrolling required
   - Layout adapts gracefully to different screen sizes
acceptance_criteria: All tests pass including responsive tests
Calculator displays correctly on all mobile viewports tested
UI is usable on touch devices
No layout breaking or horizontal scroll on mobile screens
